utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Dane, I was just thinking about the repair drive—do we still need more folks to sign up for tool shifts this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I think we could use a couple more hands. I was planning to swing by late Saturday if that works.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I'll mark you down for Saturday then. I'll be around all day if you need anything.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I have a broken lawnmower. Can you fix it?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: What seems to be wrong with it?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It won't start. Need you to check the engine.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I've been sorting through the supply donations all morning. We've got a decent pile of lumber and tools, but could use more nails.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, nails? Right, I think I saw a box of those in my shed somewhere... or maybe that was screws.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: If you could check, that'd be great—screws won't work for the framing, but nails are exactly what we need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Pia, I heard you’re organizing a repair drive. That sounds interesting.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, I'm trying to organize it, but I'm worried about getting enough volunteers and having the right tools for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Maybe I can help with tools—what kind are you thinking we'll need?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what's the deal with that repair drive—what exactly needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I think I heard something about the community center's roof—maybe some leaks? Not too sure though.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: If it's the roof, we should check it before the next big rain—have you seen where the damage is exactly?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Gus, are you going to the repair drive this Saturday? I heard they're fixing old appliances and stuff.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You bet I'll be there! I've got a van full of tools ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that's wonderful! I heard the Johnson's toaster is on the fritz again, and Mrs. Chen's vacuum cleaner sounds like it's wheezing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Opal! I'm getting the word out about the big neighborhood repair drive this Saturday. You in?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely, I'll be there. What time and where are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great! We're meeting at the community center at 9 AM. Bring any tools you have!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Kira, I heard you're organizing that repair drive. Need a hand with any tools or heavy lifting?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, you're actually serious about helping? I thought you were just making small talk.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I'm serious. I've got a truck and some tools, so just tell me what you need.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Bo! I'm so glad you stopped by. I've been putting together a list of neighbors who can help with the repair drive — would you be able to lend a hand this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, uh, yeah sure, just tell me where to show up and I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Bo! We're starting at 9 AM on Saturday at Mrs. Gable's house on Elm Street — she's got a leaky roof and some fence panels that need fixing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Eli, did you hear? We're planning a neighborhood repair drive this weekend to fix up the community garden tools.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Oh, a repair drive? I like that. What time on Saturday are we getting started?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We're starting at 10 AM on Saturday. I heard it's at the community garden. Spread the word!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I think I left my toolbox somewhere... do you remember what we're fixing again?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It's the fence at the back of my yard... the one that fell during the storm.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, the fence! Right, I think I remember now. I'll be right over with my hammer—just as soon as I find it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Ira, I heard we're putting together a repair drive this weekend — I was thinking my old toaster could finally get a second life, what about you?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: A repair drive? That sounds great — I’ve got a wobbly chair that’s been driving me nuts, maybe someone can fix it up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, a wobbly chair — perfect! I bet the folks running the drive will have that sorted in no time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane, did you hear about the repair drive this Saturday? I'm rallying everyone to lend a hand!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, a repair drive? Sounds good, I might be a bit late though—you know how I am.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: No worries, even an hour helps! I'll save you a spot with the tool kits.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: The repair drive sounds like a good idea. I've got a few things I've been meaning to fix around the house.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good to hear, Rey. I've always believed in keeping things in working order. What's at the top of your list?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That old wooden fence out back has seen better days. The last storm really did a number on it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Mara, I heard we're organizing a repair drive for the school. How can I help coordinate the schedule?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Faye! That's wonderful you're offering to help. I'm free most evenings after 6 PM, so we can sit down and figure out a schedule that works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, how about we meet tomorrow at 6 PM to start planning? I can bring a calendar and we can map out the drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Vik, how's the repair drive coming along? Need any help?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I was just going to talk to you about that! We're planning to do it this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Saturday sounds great! I can round up a few folks from my book club to help out if you need extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Pia, I heard about the repair drive. Need me to bring over my toolbox?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, that's kind of you, Gus, but I'm a bit worried about the timing—do you think we'll have enough daylight to sort everything out?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Don't worry, I've got a couple of work lights in my truck—we can set up if the sun fades.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, Rosa, did you happen to see where that repair truck ended up? I noticed it turned onto Elm Street earlier, but I lost track.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, I saw it pull into the driveway at 142 Elm—Mrs. Gable's place. She mentioned her porch steps were getting wobbly.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Good, good—that makes sense. Mrs. Gable's steps have been iffy for weeks. I'll make a note to check back later and see if they fixed the wobble.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you already check the supply room for the right tools?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Not yet, I wanted to confirm with you first which tools we actually need before I go digging around in there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We'll need a set of hex wrenches and a sturdy screwdriver—can you grab those first?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Cleo, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. Need any help with tools or setting up?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Actually, Sam, I could use a hand sorting through the donated tools. Want to come by tomorrow morning?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I'll be there tomorrow morning. Just tell me the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Noah! I've been hearing whispers about a repair drive. Can you fill me in?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, yeah, the repair drive... I think it's this Saturday? Or maybe it was last week. I'm not entirely sure.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hmm, I'm a bit lost—do you know who's organizing it or where it's happening?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure about the repair drive? That seems like a big claim.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard it's legit! The folks over on Elm Street had a broken tractor and they fixed it up in no time. I'm thinking of bringing my old blender.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Elm Street, huh? You actually saw it work yourself, or just heard about it?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Uli, any news on when that repair drive is supposed to start?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I think it's set for next Saturday morning. I heard they're meeting at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, good to know. I'll try to make it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Leo! The repair drive... right, right. I think I left my toolbox in the garage—did we need that for the project?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, grab it. We'll need the wrenches.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Alright, I'll go fetch it—just give me a moment, I think I know where I put it.
